doc: The four regimes on a 64x64 tile: level of the raw fields, the open-cell plateau, spatial smoothness of each rank channel and the correlation between regimes (the regimes must stay distinct). STATISTICAL: 24 seeds (1000..1023), 18 metrics (names and definitions in params). The port draws its own random numbers, so it cannot reproduce `values`; it computes each metric exactly as defined, for its own seeds, and checks |metric - mean| <= n_sigma * std per metric for one seed (n_sigma * std / sqrt(m) for the mean of m seeds). mean and std (ddof = 1) are what the Python code produces; the recomputation check holds them at 1e-9 (no flipped texel in the nudge experiments).
